purpose: The essential operational path of PEE, stage by stage. tests/vertical_contract.test.ts fails if a named component disappears, a cited test file is missing, or a status is not one of the defined classes. Update this file in the same commit as any change to a stage's connection or status (principles 2 and 10).

statusClasses.authentic_verified: implemented and verified with authentic data on the operational path
statusClasses.synthetic_verified: implemented and verified only with synthetic data
statusClasses.disconnected: implemented but not reachable from the request path
statusClasses.blocked: implemented but blocked by missing authorisation or authentic evidence

authenticValidationRequirement.rule: Every major capability must eventually be validated on authentic external evidence on the operational path. Synthetic verification proves wiring, not reality. Each stage records its authentic validation as done (with the run that showed it) or pending (with what it waits for).

tiers.T2_authentic_controlled: authentic evidence through the real components on a store copy, with an evaluation-only authority or proposed policy
tiers.T3_operational: authentic evidence through the operational path under authorised policy and authority

interpretationRules.note: S100 (owner review of S99, 2026-10-20, verbatim in .claude/skills/pee-guided-learning/references/owner-review-s99-rule-governance-2026-10-20.md): every rule that decides the scientific meaning of an observation is either a declarative rule of a decision program (knowledge_rules.decide applies the one precedence policy) or an imperative rule registered here with what it decides, its scope, its tier and its tests. tests/s100_rule_governance.test.ts enforces the registry; a new contradicting declarative rule fails to load.

policy.text: Claims carry a tier (constraint > explicit > inherited > default) and a scope (value < cell < clause < header < row < sentence < table < section < document < source). The highest tier present decides; within it the narrowest scope decides. Claims that disagree at the deciding tier and scope are a conflict: the field stays undecided and the conflict is reported (never settled by rule order). A default is only a presumption: it is reported and never decides. The most specific rule does not win by being specific: an explicit statement about the occurrence outranks inherited context at any scope, and inherited context of a narrower scope outranks a wider one.
loadTimeChecks: every claim rule states a constant field, value and tier
fields, values and scopes are declared
rules that can conclude different values of one field at one tier and scope must be declared in a contested group (values, scopes, reason)
every cue kind used by a rule is declared and produced by a registered reader (CUE_READERS)
